findings.topic: AI text and short-story prompts in Agent
findings.fact: Agent assigns the real reply to its answer state and displays it in _AnswerBubble. Visible response actions are Vorlesen and Stopp; quick questions can ask for a three-sentence story. Text requests go to the configured base URL plus /chat after the enabled learning-area guard and input filter; returned text is filtered before use. In the inspected output UI no report/rating or individual-result delete action is bound. Conversation history is an in-memory list capped to eight turns and cleared on context change/dispose.
findings.limit: No server-side deletion or handling of a complaint is established.

findings.topic: Teacher text and online generated images
findings.fact: Teacher questions call the same chat client with learningTutor context and place the reply in chat bubbles. On unavailable cloud response a local fallback can be retried. For requested images, and eligible proactive Sachkunde topics, _generateImage reads aiProxyEnabled and calls buildSafeImageUrl. Without allowOnline the generator returns null. Enabled URL content is built from fixed topic/color translations and fetched by Image.network from image.pollinations.ai. The inspected bubble has text/image/loading/error display but no bound report/rating/delete action.
findings.limit: The provider flags and local allowlist are source behavior, not proof of provider output safety or a reporting service. No provider was contacted.

findings.topic: Learning help, task cache and visual aid distinction
findings.fact: Online task hints use the real ask client; cloud replies populate _aiHelpReply and a visible _AiHelpBubble with a speak callback. AiTutorService requests task batches and stores validated drafts in AiTaskCache. Settings can clear local task/metadata keys per child, subject and grades. Although LumoVisualAidService contains a /visual-aid request, the observed LearningContent UI call explicitly passes settings.copyWith(aiProxyEnabled:false); that actual path remains local.
findings.limit: The dormant /visual-aid implementation must not be presented as an active online transfer from the inspected learning UI. Cached-task removal is not provider-side deletion.

findings.fact: Story setup calls local generateReadingAdventure, which assembles text from in-source templates. Reader uses LumoStoryScene with Canvas and bundled Image.asset art. The old generator header mentioning live Pollinations does not describe this inspected active route. A short story requested in Agent is a separate possible /chat response.
findings.limit: No claim that all narrative content everywhere is local; this finding is restricted to the actual setup/reader route.

findings.fact: Finishing a new story calls addStory. Library has favorite and confirmed Geschichte löschen actions; delete removes that story from the local list and persists the JSON collection through SharedPreferences. Save failure restores the prior in-memory list and propagates the error.
findings.limit: This removes the stored local book. It does not report content or establish deletion from any external provider.

findings.fact: Settings parent-advisor asks the chat client with parentAdvisor context, assigns response.reply, and displays it as Text. In the inspected result container there is no bound report/rating/server-delete action.
findings.limit: Other parenting/permission/privacy details are owned by the parent audit; no broad account or operator review was added.

findings.fact: The Diagnose error-log UI offers copy, show/hide and delete. Copy invokes Clipboard.setData. Its text asks the person to send copied diagnostics to Claude, but this code binds no recipient address, reporting endpoint, mail composer or automatic transmission. Delete clears the in-memory error list and removes local SharedPreferences key lumo_error_log_v1.
findings.limit: This is crash-diagnostics handling, not a result-linked AI content complaint flow. External recipients and actual delivery are not established.

additional_findings.fact: The merge removes the nullable generated-image URL field and its Image.network presentation branch, and changes the Word Magic promise to explaining a word. The real Word Magic handler calls LumoBrain.ask and passes reply.text to its visible/spoken message; this ask implementation uses local patterns/templates and returns empty non-confident text when unmatched, with no online handoff in the inspected handler. The photo quiz displays Image.file from the camera-returned path and asks the fixed _extendedPhotoQuestions. Safari displays the source's animal emoji map. Result UI/actions show messages, close/mode/photo/speech/next-animal controls; no result-bound complaint/rating/server-delete action was added in these diffs.
additional_findings.limit: Do not label the removed pre-existing network-image branch an observed active image request: the inspected former state field had no non-null assignment. Resetting the in-memory captured path on mode switch is not evidence of deleting the captured file. Speech/TTS SDK transport and whole-app privacy are outside this narrow source review.
